scope: Complete 0.7.0 App Store and Google Play metadata candidate, complete candidate website copy, all candidate screenshot captions, and the bounded 252-work art-count supplement and candidate deltas in docs/marketing/store-web-2026-09-13.

roles.role: Textual accuracy, source anchors, philology, and claims
roles.findings: Verified 24 translation editions in 11 modern languages plus Ancient Greek; 3,288 passage-anchored notes; 252 distinct live historical-art identities across the whole library, comprising a 230-work museum-gallery subset from 48 museums and collections plus 22 chapter-only historical works; and 54 DOI-identified articles represented by 68 citation placements, including 42 with direct full-text URLs. Approved the bounded art-count delta after the original wording corrections.

roles.role: Reader usefulness, clarity, art relevance, and provenance
roles.findings: Approved the candidate voice and reader value after correcting museum-only collection wording, publisher-link wording, and the implication that every gallery record has artist and date metadata. Independently confirmed 252 historical artworks and objects for the whole library, with 230 in the museum-gallery subset and 22 chapter-only works, and required a comma in the Open Graph description plus historical works in place of historical illustrations.

Resolved both base reviews by using museums and collections, DOI links, and collection, source, and rights metadata; adopted the factual 24 translations, to read and compare screenshot caption; and resolved the art supplement as 252 historical artworks and objects across the whole library, including the 230-work museum-gallery subset from 48 museums and collections plus 22 chapter-only historical works. Applied the reader review's comma and historical works edits. The unchanged captions retain 230 because they depict the museum-gallery subset.

resolved_decision_notes: Use 48 museums and collections because the 48 catalog groups include museums, galleries, a national library, a palace, and named collections.
Use DOI link for the 12 citation-only articles; 42 of the 54 distinct articles have direct full-text URLs online in addition to DOI links.
Describe artwork details as collection, source, and rights because artist and date metadata are not present on every catalog record.
Use 252 historical artworks and objects for the whole library: 230 belong to the museum gallery from 48 museums and collections, and 22 are chapter-only historical works.
The promotional text names 252 artworks and objects and remains within the 170-byte limit.
Use a comma before and references in the Open Graph description, and use historical works rather than historical illustrations for the 22 chapter-only identities.
Use 24 translations, to read and compare in screenshot captions to keep the claim factual and matter of fact.
Retain the version 0.7.0 preview notice and all unaffected candidate copy as approved. Store copy remains staged for the upcoming release.
retained_candidate_copy: APPROVED: every base and art-delta candidate byte not superseded by the resolved decision notes is retained and approved.
registry_amendment: The final base reports were reread after their last edits. The 68 figure denotes citation-note placements across 59 distinct anchored line spans, not distinct articles; the public copy correctly states 54 distinct DOI-identified articles and 42 direct full-text links online. The later bounded art-count supplement changed the approved store and website bytes to the reviewed 252-work whole-library total while preserving 230 as the museum-gallery caption scope.
